intended_object: An auxiliary canonical isomorphism of commutative Hopf algebras. It identifies the coordinate Hopf algebra of the weight-unipotent subgroup of GL_N, k[GL_N]/I_U, with the quotient of the weight-parabolic coordinate algebra k[GL_N]/I_P by the image of I_U. The docstring says it is the "quotient-coordinate isomorphism underlying" an identification of group schemes.
explanation:
The body has two steps:
1. An `eqToIso` rewrites the defining ideal as the comap of the relative ideal along the surjection q : k[GL_N] → k[P].
2. `quotientIsoOfSurjective` then gives the third-isomorphism-theorem identification of quotients.

The docstring calls it the isomorphism "underlying" something else. Its only use is right after it: applying `hopfSpec` to it, via `mapIso`, gives the group-scheme isomorphism `weightUnipotentInParabolicGroupSchemeIso`. A simp lemma recording how it commutes with the two quotient maps sits between the two.

So it is proof plumbing: a bridge between two Lean presentations of the same quotient, built to transport structure. It is not a standalone notion from the literature. Mathematically it is just the canonical map (A/J) ≅ (A/I)/(J/I) for I ≤ J. That map is correct by construction, being the third isomorphism theorem in the category of Hopf algebras.
